name: Daedalus's Hoard
purpose: Generate local 3D models from images across four GPUs, optionally refine a separate version, compare geometry and export explicitly scaled GLB, STL or PLY files.
notes: Generation and refinement return asynchronous job IDs. Read actual completion with job_get. Refinement chooses DetailGen3D or UltraShape, token count, steps and copy alignment; outputs return to the original frame. Legacy requests retain Detail defaults. Refinement preserves the original and may reduce quality; it is optional. GLB uses meters and STL/PLY millimeters with explicit export scale. No automatic print repair, retopology or rigging. Text reasoning uses the shared Sparks through Faustus.
